The '''Moskk system''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Albarrio sector/Legends|Albarrio sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> that was several [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] away from the [[Gwori system/Legends|Gwori system]] and had at least two [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and two [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. A [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] task force under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] used the system around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] as a staging area for an [[Battle of Gwori|attack]] on [[Gwori]] and its [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]].<ref name="SoD" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', the Moskk system is misspelled "Mossk" on the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] map. Despite its description as being a several sectors away from [[Gwori]], the system is located in the sector directly adjacent to [[Clacis sector/Legends|Gwori's sector]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
